description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 5999016010436 TRANSPONDER UNIT: Line 0001 Qty 5 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0302 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract).
